

```{r wb_setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(cmdstanr)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

filename <- "../datasets/wb2022.csv"
filename2 <- "../datasets/wb_country.csv"

# build a variable label vector for better labelling of df
label_vec <- read_csv(filename) |>
  distinct(`Series Code`, `Series Name`) |>
  filter(!is.na(`Series Code`), !is.na(`Series Name`)) |>
  group_by(`Series Code`) |> # in case of duplicates
  summarise(label = first(`Series Name`), .groups = "drop") |>
  with(setNames(label, `Series Code`))

# compose dataframe
df <- read_csv(filename) |>
  select(-c(`Series Name`)) |>
  slice(1:(n() - 5)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^\\d{4} \\[YR\\d{4}\\]$"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "value",
    names_transform = list(year = ~ str_extract(.x, "^\\d{4}"))
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Series Code`, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(across(
    any_of(names(label_vec)),
    ~ {
      attr(.x, "label") <- unname(label_vec[cur_column()])
      .x
    }
  )) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(filename2),
    join_by(`Country Code` == Code)
  )

```

```{r raw_output}
tibble(column = variables) |>
```

# Variable Distributions
Red dotted line indicates value for Nepal; blue line is mean, and blue rectangle is the range of -1 to 1 standard units.
```{r variable_plots}
plots <- variables |>
  keep(~ .x %in% names(df) && is.numeric(df[[.x]])) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    \(v) {
      x_lab <- attr(df[[v]], "label") %||% v

      x_vals <- df[[v]]
      x_vals_non_na <- x_vals[!is.na(x_vals)]

      # Summary stats
      mean_val <- mean(x_vals_non_na)
      sd_val <- sd(x_vals_non_na)

      nepal_value <- df |>
        filter(`Country Name` == "Nepal") |>
        pull(.data[[v]]) |>
        first()

      # Detect whether values are effectively integers
      is_integerish <- length(x_vals_non_na) > 0 &&
        all(abs(x_vals_non_na - round(x_vals_non_na)) < 1e-8)

      # Choose histogram settings automatically
      if (is_integerish && diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) <= 50) {
        hist_geom <- geom_histogram(
          binwidth = 1,
          boundary = -0.5,
          color = "gray40",
          fill = "gray80",
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        # Freedman-Diaconis rule for continuous variables
        iqr_val <- IQR(x_vals_non_na)
        n_val <- length(x_vals_non_na)

        fd_binwidth <- 2 * iqr_val / (n_val^(1 / 3))
        fd_binwidth <- 0.5 * fd_binwidth

        # Fallback if IQR is zero or binwidth is not usable
        if (!is.finite(fd_binwidth) || fd_binwidth <= 0) {
          rng <- diff(range(x_vals_non_na))
          fd_binwidth <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng / 30 else 1
        }

        hist_geom <- geom_histogram(
          binwidth = fd_binwidth,
          color = "gray40",
          fill = "gray80",
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }

      caption_text <- paste0(
        "Mean = ",
        scales::number(mean_val, accuracy = 0.01),
        "   |   SD = ",
        scales::number(sd_val, accuracy = 0.01)
      )

      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]])) +
        hist_geom +
        annotate(
          "rect",
          xmin = mean_val - sd_val,
          xmax = mean_val + sd_val,
          ymin = -Inf,
          ymax = Inf,
          fill = "blue",
          alpha = 0.12
        ) +
        geom_vline(
          xintercept = mean_val,
          color = "blue",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          alpha = 0.48
        ) +
        # geom_vline(
        #   xintercept = c(mean_val - sd_val, mean_val + sd_val),
        #   color = "blue",
        #   linetype = "dashed",
        #   linewidth = 0.8
        # ) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Histogram of", x_lab),
          x = x_lab,
          y = "Count",
          caption = caption_text
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.caption = element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            margin = margin(t = 8)
          ),
          plot.caption.position = "plot"
        )

      if (!is.na(nepal_value)) {
        p <- p +
          geom_vline(
            xintercept = nepal_value,
            color = "red",
            linetype = "dotted",
            linewidth = 0.8
          )
      }

      p
    }
  )

walk(plots, print)
```

# Exposure-Outcome Scatterplots
```{r scatterplots}
scatter_plots <- histograms |>
  purrr::map(\(xy) {
    x_var <- xy[[1]]
    y_var <- xy[[2]]

    x_lab <- attr(df[[x_var]], "label") %||% x_var
    y_lab <- attr(df[[y_var]], "label") %||% y_var

    ggplot(
      df,
      aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]])
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        formula = "y ~ x",
        se = FALSE,
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(y_lab, " vs ", x_lab),
        x = x_lab,
        y = y_lab
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  })

purrr::walk(scatter_plots, print)
```

```{r parameter_plot_function}

plot_param <- function(draws, param, prior_sd = BETA_SD) {
  ggplot(draws, aes(x = .data[[param]])) +
    stat_function(
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = 0, sd = prior_sd),
      color = "indianred3",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_density(
      fill = "cornflowerblue",
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    stat_pointinterval(
      aes(y = 0),
      point_interval = median_qi
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3 * BETA_SD, 3 * BETA_SD)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.35)) +
    labs(
      title = param,
      x = param,
      y = "Density"
    )
}
```
